title: We live in a culture that wants the comfort without the confrontation. We want a God who just hugs us in our mess, rather than one who loves us enough to pull us out of it.
paragraphs: We live in a culture that wants the comfort without the confrontation. We want a God who just hugs us in our mess, rather than one who loves us enough to pull us out of it.

Real love isn't just an affirmation; it's a consuming fire. 🔥 It shines a light on the deepest parts of our souls—the parts we try to hide—not to shame us, but to heal us. The confrontation is the mercy. You cannot be transformed by a truth you refuse to face.
Are you willing to step into the fire to find freedom?
📖 "For the Lord disciplines the one he loves, and chastises every son whom he receives." – Hebrews 12:6
